name: Flip Overlay Gallery
description: Editorial index of titled entries with a hover preview thumbnail and metadata. Selecting an entry opens a full dossier overlay, where the title and image morph into place with GSAP Flip.
contents: Header with eyebrow, intro and entry count
Preview thumbnail frame with corner ticks and live metadata readout
List of large entry titles with code and region labels
Full-page dossier overlay per entry with hero image, two side images and field note
behavior: Hovering a title swaps the preview image and metadata and dims other titles
Click opens the dossier, Flip animates the title and image into the overlay while other titles slide away
Back button or Escape reverses the animation
Sizes scale with viewport width through a root font size, stacking preview above the list below 768px

props.name: intro
props.default: Five quiet places, indexed by light and elevation. Hover to preview, select to open the dossier.

props.name: footerHint
props.default: Select an entry to open its dossier

editableByProps: All entries, texts, images, labels and codes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the hover dimming of other titles
Change the order or stagger of the open and close animation
needsCodeEdit.where: openOverlay and closeOverlay functions inside the useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the corner tick style of the preview frame

fixed: Loads the Bricolage Grotesque and JetBrains Mono Google Fonts stylesheet into document head
Listens for the Escape key on document while mounted and removes it on unmount
Root is at least one viewport tall with hidden overflow
Text sizes scale with viewport width and are floored at a 6px root size, so small phones show compact text
